free_tier.stated: A trial of $0 for 7 days with 2 sandboxes at once, giving $0.90 of sandbox time, 25 hours of 4 vCPUs and 8 GiB, that needs a card to start; after the trial every sandbox needs a paid plan.
free_tier.notes: The $0.90 credit at the default 2 vCPU and 4 GiB rate of $0.018 an hour is 50 hours; the docs quote 25 hours of the larger 4 vCPU and 8 GiB size. The free tier for model inference on spare capacity with a verified phone is a separate offer and is recorded under inference/munito.

per_object_cap.stated: 100 MiB per file written through the sandbox file API
per_object_cap.notes: The unit is a machine, not a stored object; the file limit is the closest published per-item ceiling.

retention.stated: A sandbox lives 10 to 86,400 seconds and defaults to 3,600 seconds; at most 7,200 seconds during the trial. A paused persistent sandbox keeps files and processes while its saved state bills at $0.0002 per GiB-hour.

egress.terms: unverified: no egress price or allowance is published for sandboxes; a new sandbox has no outbound internet access until internet is set to true, and inbound reaches it only through ports and SSH

interface_detail: A TypeScript client and an npm CLI create sandboxes, run commands and write files through a REST API; shells, SSH, open ports and a desktop are available inside a sandbox.
tooling: npm install -g @munitoai/cli, then munito login, munito create, munito exec and munito rm; the TypeScript client is @munitoai/cli.
chaining: A 2 vCPU and 4 GiB sandbox at $0.018 an hour supplies an isolated Linux machine for agents; a paused persistent sandbox keeps a warmed toolchain for forks, and files must be copied to a separate object-storage record for long-term retention.

limits.value: $0.90 of sandbox time for 7 days, or 25 hours of 4 vCPUs and 8 GiB, then a paid plan
API requests from one IP address are limited to 8,000 a minute
100 MiB per file; command output 1 MiB for each stream when waiting for the result

limits_note: During the trial an organization runs 2 sandboxes at once, each at most 4 vCPUs and 8 GiB; command runs last 1 to 1,800 seconds. A new sandbox starts with no outbound internet access.
binding_note: The $0.90 credit for 7 days runs out before the 8,000-per-minute IP rate or the per-file cap does.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up offers GitHub, Google or email (https://console.munito.ai/registration). The sandbox trial needs a card saved on the Billing page: 'Add a card to start' and 'To start, add a card on the Billing page of the console. The card is not charged then.' No phone or identity document is asked for to start a sandbox; a verified phone appears only on the separate model-inference free tier.

reliability_note: A create, resume, fork or new timeout is refused with 402 if there is no card, no plan or no credit; when the trial credit runs out, running sandboxes stop with end_reason credits. Sandboxes on one host share its vCPUs, so a busy host slows commands.
confidence_note: The plan table, trial credit, rates, limits and card gate are read from the vendor's pricing and sandbox-pricing pages on 2026-11-25 and quoted below. The egress price was not published and is left unverified.
